chunks.title: Load
chunks.text: Scrape off large food, bones and toothpicks. Empty glasses and cups. Rinse only if the dishes will wait before washing.

chunks.title: Load
chunks.text: Upper basket: glasses, cups, small plates and plastics marked dishwasher safe. Open side down, tilted slightly.

chunks.title: Load
chunks.text: Lower basket: plates, bowls, pots and pans facing down. Items up to 11 inches tall. Fold the tines down for big pots.

chunks.title: Load
chunks.text: Cutlery basket: knives and sharp items pointing down.

chunks.title: Load
chunks.text: Turn the spray arm under the upper basket by hand: nothing should stop it or block the detergent cup.

chunks.title: Load
chunks.text: If the dishwasher drains into the sink's garbage disposal, run the disposal first so it is empty.

chunks.title: Detergent and rinse aid
chunks.text: Push the release catch to open the detergent cup.

chunks.title: Detergent and rinse aid
chunks.text: Add automatic dishwasher detergent, then press the cover down until it closes. The cover is always open again at the end of a cycle: normal.

chunks.title: Detergent and rinse aid
chunks.text: Rinse aid (liquid only) helps dishes dry. Check the window next to the cup. To fill, lift the tab, fill up to the full mark (not past it), press the cover down. It lasts about a month.

chunks.title: Detergent and rinse aid
chunks.text: Never put detergent in the rinse aid side, and never use powder or solid rinse aid.

chunks.title: Cycle and options
chunks.text: Normal Wash: everyday loads. Heavy Wash: pots, pans, casseroles. 1 Hour Wash: lightly soiled, no drying. China Crystal: delicate china and glass. Energy Saver: lightly soiled, pre-rinsed dishes.

chunks.title: Cycle and options
chunks.text: Rinse Only: rinses now so food doesn't dry on until you run a full load. No detergent.

chunks.title: Cycle and options
chunks.text: Press Options to choose Sanitize (Heavy and Normal only), High Temp or Heat Dry. A light shows what is on.

chunks.title: Cycle and options
chunks.text: Delay: press Delay until the hours (1h to 24h) show, then press START/Cancel.

chunks.title: Cycle and options
chunks.text: Control Lock: hold Options and Delay together for 3 seconds. Do the same to unlock.

chunks.title: Start and finish
chunks.text: Close the door until it latches and press START/Cancel. The display shows the minutes left. The time can jump up or down: normal.

chunks.title: Start and finish
chunks.text: Cancel: hold START/Cancel for 3 seconds.

chunks.title: Start and finish
chunks.text: Add a dish: open the door a little and wait for the spraying to stop. Add the dish, close the door firmly and press START/Cancel.

chunks.title: Start and finish
chunks.text: At the end it beeps and the Clean light stays on until you open the door (Sanitized if you chose Sanitize). Dishes can be hot.

chunks.title: Outside and inside
chunks.text: Wipe spills as they happen. Soft damp cloth on the control panel. Stainless door: stainless steel cleaner and a soft cloth.

chunks.title: Outside and inside
chunks.text: Wipe the inside and the inner door with a wet dishcloth.

chunks.title: Outside and inside
chunks.text: Now and then, fill the detergent cup and run it empty on Normal Wash with Sanitize.

chunks.title: Outside and inside
chunks.text: White spots or smell: run Normal Wash empty with no detergent. Once water has run through, open the door, put an 8 oz cup of white vinegar upright in the lower basket, close and let it finish.

chunks.title: Clean the filters
chunks.text: Turn the dishwasher off and let the heating element cool.

chunks.title: Clean the filters
chunks.text: Turn the filter insert counterclockwise and lift it out.

chunks.title: Clean the filters
chunks.text: Pull out the flat, rectangular fine filter.

chunks.title: Clean the filters
chunks.text: Remove food and rinse the filters under running water.

chunks.title: Put filters back, spray arm
chunks.text: Put the filters back in reverse order. Turn the insert clockwise to the close arrow. If it is not closed properly, it cleans less well.

chunks.title: Put filters back, spray arm
chunks.text: Dishes not clean or holes blocked: pull the lower spray arm straight up, gently.

chunks.title: Put filters back, spray arm
chunks.text: Clear the holes, push it back and spin it by hand to check it turns.

chunks.title: Door seal and rinse aid
chunks.text: Door not closing well or leaking: wipe the door seal with a damp cloth to remove food.

chunks.title: Door seal and rinse aid
chunks.text: Check the rinse aid window about once a month. Lift the tab, fill with liquid rinse aid up to the full mark (not past it), press the cover down firmly.

chunks.title: Code or won't start
chunks.text: i1: water takes too long to come in (supply off or low pressure). Contact property management if it happens again.

chunks.title: Code or won't start
chunks.text: i4: leaking. Turn it off and contact property management.

chunks.title: Code or won't start
chunks.text: Won't start: close the door until it latches. Delay light on: hold START/Cancel 3 seconds to cancel. Controls do nothing: hold Options and Delay 3 seconds (Control Lock). Check the plug and breaker.

chunks.title: Long cycles, dirty dishes
chunks.text: Heavy soil and Sanitize make cycles longer. Not-hot incoming water does too: avoid running it during showers. A beep at the end is normal.

chunks.title: Long cycles, dirty dishes
chunks.text: Not clean: don't load too close together; make sure the spray arms turn freely; use fresh detergent; choose Heavy Wash for very dirty loads.

chunks.title: Long cycles, dirty dishes
chunks.text: Clean the filters (see Appliance Care). Detergent left in the cup: old detergent, or a dish blocked the spray arm.

chunks.title: Wet, spotty or marked
chunks.text: Wet dishes, spots or film: fill with fresh rinse aid and choose a cycle with drying or Heat Dry.

chunks.title: Wet, spotty or marked
chunks.text: Black or grey marks: aluminium pans rubbed against dishes. Load them apart.

chunks.title: Wet, spotty or marked
chunks.text: Reddish tomato stains: run Rinse Only right after loading. Coffee or tea stains: use a dishwasher spot cleaner.

chunks.title: Water, suds or noise
chunks.text: Water left at the bottom: the cycle was stopped. Run a cycle to the end.

chunks.title: Water, suds or noise
chunks.text: Won't drain: run the sink's garbage disposal so it is empty. Still not draining: contact property management.

chunks.title: Water, suds or noise
chunks.text: Suds or leaks: use only automatic dishwasher detergent, never hand dish soap.

chunks.title: Water, suds or noise
chunks.text: Detergent cup and drain pump noises are normal. Grinding means a hard object got in: if it keeps going after a full cycle, contact property management.

chunks.title: Water, suds or noise
chunks.text: Won't fill: close the door fully. If it still won't fill, contact property management.

13 BEFORE YOU CALL PROBLEM POSSIBLE CAUSES SOLUTIONS Dishwasher won’t start Dishwasher won’t start. Power supply or power line is not connected. Delay option has been selected. Control Lock activated (select models). Shut the door completely make sure it is latched. Check and connect the power supply. Refer to Delay section in this manual to reset. Deactivate the Control Lock, refer to Control Lock section in this manual.
Dishwasher beeps at the end of the cycle The wash cycle will beep to indicate the end of the cycle.

Dishwasher operates too long The dishwasher is connected to cold water. The cycle time will vary due to the soil. The sanitize option is selected. Check the dishwasher, make sure it is properly connected to the hot water supply. When heavy soil is detected, some cycles will automatically increase the cycle time. When sanitize option is selected, the cycle time will be increase to meet the sanitized temperature request.
Dishes are not clean enough Water pressure is temporarily low. The inlet water temperature is low. Dishes are loaded too close together. Improper use of detergent.

The selected cycle is not suitable for food soil condition. Spay arms is blocked by some items. Use you dishwasher when the water pressure is normal. Make sure the dishwasher is connected to the hot water supply Try not use your dishwasher when hot water is being used elsewhere in the house. Load the dishes again as per the manual. Add detergent depending on the water hardness and the cycle you chose. Use fresh detergent. Choose anther cycle for longer washing time. Make sure the spay arm is rotated freely.

Dishes not dry enough Rinse aid dispenser is empty. Improper loading of dishes. The cycle you chose did not included the drying. Fill rinse aid dispenser or increase the amount of rinse aid. Load the dishes again as the manual instructs. Choose the proper cycle with drying.

Spots and film on dishes Water hardness is too high. Improper loading of dishes. Old rinse aid is used. Rinse dispenser empty. For extremely hard water install a water softener. Load the dishes again as the manual indicates. Use fresh rinse aid. Add rinse aid to the dispenser. Before calling for service, review this list. It may save you both time and expense. This list includes common experiences that are not the result of defective workman ship or material in your dishwasher.

14 BEFORE YOU CALL PROBLEM POSSIBLE CAUSES SOLUTIONS Etching Using too much detergent. The inlet water temperature exceeds 158°F (70°C). Use less detergent if you have soft water. Lower the inlet water temperature. Detergent left in dispenser cup Detergent may be too old. Spray arm is blocked. Use fresh detergent. Load the dishes, making sure the spray arms are not blocked.

Detergent dispenser will not shut Improper operation of the detergent cover. Add the detergent and rinse aid as indicated by the manual. Water remains in the dishwasher Previous cycle has not finished or has been interrupted. Select the proper cycle explained in the manual. Dishwasher does not drain properly Drain is clogged. Drain hose is kinked. Check the air gap if you have one.

Make sure the disposer is empty if dishwasher is connected to disposer. Make sure the drain hose is properly connected to the sink. Suds in the tub Improper detergent is used. Make sure to use only the automatic dishwasher detergent. Dishwasher leaks Excessive suds caused by using the improper detergent. Dishwasher is not level. Make sure to use only the proper dishwasher detergent. Level the dishwasher.

Black or gray marks on dishes Aluminum utensils have rubbed against dishes. Rearrange the dishes. Stained tub interior Coffee and tea soil. Reddish stain. Using an approved spot cleaner to remove the soil. Some tomato-based foods will cause this, use of the rinse only cycle right after loading this will decrease the staining.

Noises Detergent cup opening\ Drain pump sound. A hard object has entered the wash module. When the object is ground up, the sound should stop. This is normal. If the noise persists after a complete cycle, call for service. Dishwasher won’t fill with water Water valve is turn off. Door latch may not be properly seated. Check if the water valve is turn on. Make sure the door is closed.

15 Error Codes Error codes will display on the display window when the following errors occur: Code Meaning Possible Causes i1 Longer inlet time Faucets is not opened, or water intake is restricted, or water pressure is too low. i4

Unit leaking Some element of dishwasher leaks. BEFORE YOU CALL WARNING If overflow occurs, turn off the main water supply before calling a service provider. If there is water in the base pan because of an overfill or small leak, the water should be removed before restarting the dishwasher.
